title: Remove a specified AGV via Geek request (RemoveAgv) using robot ID
summary: Send the OptiSweep-to-Geek AGV API request function RemoveAgv with the required robot ID to remove the specified AGV from the system.
when_to_use: Use when you need to remove a specific AGV from the system by issuing the OptiSweep AGVs RemoveAgv request to Geek, and you have the required robot ID for that AGV.
not_for: Do not proceed without a robot ID (the source states RemoveAgv requires the robot ID).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Issue the OptiSweep AGVs RemoveAgv request to Geek using the required robot ID and verify the request was issued for the intended robot ID.
access_or_tools_needed: Robot ID for the specified AGV
API Dog (API client) on the primary servers (as described in the source)

access_required: Access to OptiSweep APIs (AGVs) to send the RemoveAgv request
